correction_after_first_target_run: An independent histogram checker exposed floating-point tie sensitivity. The first exploratory runner summed target weights in ciphertext order, mathematically equivalent to the source column objective but not the C++ execution order. The first results file was discarded, not published. The final runner and independent checker divide each decrypted-rune histogram by column length and then sum in rune-index order, exactly as the pinned C++ source. Source C++ parity was checked on pages 17, 40 and 72 at each frozen period. The original plan axes, controls and null generation did not change.
first_exploratory_summary: Before correction, the best output was LP2-55/KL5 score -6.778222109792523; 108/199 full-search null maxima were at least as high. Those provisional results are not the archived final receipt.
final_receipt: results.json is the source-order implementation checked independently by check.py; 107/199 null maxima at least as high.
